terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.article1Body: These terms govern the basic rights, obligations, responsibilities, and conditions of service between CraftDay ("Company") and users regarding the website and application ("Service").
terms.article2Item1Text: Refers to the entire workshop reservation and community platform provided by the Company.
terms.article2Item2Text: Includes all members and non-members using this Service.
terms.article2Item3Text: A person who registers personal information to access and continuously use the Service.
terms.article2Item4Text: A member who operates a workshop and manages reservation products on the Service.
terms.article3Body: When modifying these terms, the Company will announce the effective date and reasons at least 7 days prior to implementation. If users do not agree to revised terms, they may terminate their user agreement.
terms.article4Sub: The Company provides the following services to users:
terms.article4Item1: Workshop class information provision & reservation agency
terms.article4Item3: User community information sharing & review creation
terms.article4Item4: Other services developed or partnered by the Company
terms.disclaimer: These terms are for demonstration purposes only and hold no legal effect. This is a CraftDay demo UI.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Body: The Company collects the following personal data for sign-up, inquiry, and service requests.
privacy.section1Item1: Required: Name, email address, password, access logs, cookies, IP address
privacy.section1Item2: Optional: Mobile number, profile picture (user settings)
privacy.section1Item3: Payment: Masked card number, card alias, payment approval records
privacy.section2Body: The Company uses collected personal information for the following purposes.
privacy.section2Item1: Contract fulfillment & fee settlement for service provision
privacy.section2Item2: Member management (verification, prevention of unauthorized use, complaint handling)
privacy.section3Body: In principle, personal data is destroyed without delay once purposes are fulfilled. However, statutory retention policies apply as defined by law.
privacy.section3Item1: Records on contract or withdrawal: 5 years
privacy.section3Item2: Records on payment and supply of goods: 5 years
privacy.section3Item3: Records on consumer complaints or dispute resolution: 3 years
privacy.disclaimer: This Privacy Policy is for demo purposes only and has no legal effect.
